stories.title: Dowagiac Neighbors Sue Over nonstop Noise From Crypto Data Center
stories.dek: Residents say the high-pitched whine from Alliance Cloud Services has made yards and open windows unusable for two years. The company, already fined under Dowagiac's new limits, plans to seal vents after switching to AI but faces demands for real soundproofing or buyouts.

stories.title: Michigan regulators say lawmakers can cut power prices amid data center growth
stories.dek: State energy regulators told lawmakers that new policies could lower electricity rates even as data centers increase demand. The comments come as multiple Michigan counties weigh large computing projects. Residents could see bill impacts depending on how the legislature acts on power planning.
stories.source_title: Michigan lawmakers could lower power prices, energy regulators argue - The Detroit News

stories.title: Chippewa County blocks new data centers for a year
stories.dek: Chippewa County supervisors approved a 12-month moratorium on data center proposals. The pause gives officials time to study power, water and zoning impacts before any large projects move forward. Residents in the rural Upper Peninsula county now have a temporary shield from rapid industrial development.
stories.source_title: Chippewa County passes 12-month moratorium on data centers - WKOW

stories.title: Michigan residents sue data center over constant noise
stories.dek: Locals near an operating Michigan facility claim the hum and vibrations are ruining sleep and property values. The lawsuit tests whether existing noise rules can rein in hyperscale operations. A win or loss here could set precedent for other townships facing similar complaints.
stories.source_title: Residents In Michigan Are Suing A Data Center Over Noise Pollution - bgr.com

stories.title: Wixom moves to tighten rules as data center moratorium deadline hits
stories.dek: Wixom city council is drafting new zoning rules for data centers just weeks before its six-month moratorium expires. The measures aim to limit noise, setbacks and power infrastructure near homes. Residents in this Oakland County suburb have pressed for stronger protections against large facilities.
stories.source_title: Wixom city council takes steps to regulate data centers as 6-month moratorium nears end - WXYZ Channel 7

stories.title: Corunna tightens rules for any future data centers
stories.dek: The city adopted a new ordinance spelling out where and how large data centers could operate. Residents gain clearer limits on noise, traffic and power use before any project advances. The rules give Shiawassee County communities a template if similar proposals appear nearby.
stories.source_title: Corunna ordinance regulates potential data centers - WJRT ABC12

stories.title: Ypsilanti Township rejects University of Michigan data center site
stories.dek: Township officials told U-M the proposed computing facility does not fit local zoning or resident concerns over power and water. The pushback blocks the project from moving forward on the chosen parcel. Washtenaw County residents now watch whether the university seeks another location or scales back plans.
stories.source_title: Township pushes back against data center proposal in Ypsilanti Township - ClickOnDetroit | WDIV Local 4

stories.title: Garfield Township weighs year-long data center freeze
stories.dek: Planners will vote tonight on findings that could pause new proposals while the township studies power and land-use impacts. Northern Michigan communities are seeing rising interest from developers seeking cheap land and cool air. A moratorium would buy time for residents to weigh costs versus tax revenue.
stories.source_title: Garfield Township planners take up data center moratorium findings tonight - 9and10News.com

stories.title: Garfield Township Builds Record for 18-Month Data Center Pause
stories.dek: Planners will forward findings to trustees showing why the old zoning rules cannot handle today's large facilities and why a moratorium is needed to avoid lawsuits like the one in Saline Township.

stories.title: East Lansing Lengthens Data Center Pause to Block Aquifer Pollution
stories.dek: Council extended the six-month moratorium to March so new zoning can bar projects that would pollute water or make neighborhoods unlivable.

stories.title: Lawsuit challenges pause blocking planned server facility, tax revenue at stake
stories.dek: A developer is suing Wixom after the city extended its pause on new data centers. The lawsuit claims the moratorium exceeds local authority and blocks a planned project. Oakland County residents could see delayed tax revenue and jobs if the case succeeds.
stories.source_title: Developer Sues City of Wixom Over Data Center Moratorium - WHMI

national.title: Data centers advance rapidly as regulators scramble for rules
national.dek: Across the U.S., officials race to impose guardrails on power-hungry facilities while communities push back on incentives and impacts.
